title: String-typed enumerations force caller validation
description:
Multiple API types use String where an enum would prevent invalid states at compile time:
- visibility field (mastodon_api Status, funkwhale TrackResponse/CreateTrackRequest, bookwyrm PlaylistResponse) accepts arbitrary strings but only 'public'/'unlisted'/'private'/'direct' are valid
- SetReadingStatusRequest.status (bookwyrm_api.rs:138) accepts any string but only 'to-read'/'reading'/'read' are valid per reading_stats() in books_db.rs
- RateBookRequest.rating (bookwyrm_api.rs:144) is i32 but only 1-5 is valid -- no validation documented
- Status.language (mastodon_api.rs:27) and media_type (mastodon_api.rs:69) are Strings
Each of these forces every downstream server to write the same validation boilerplate. This is the 'defensive-code-forcing' anti-pattern.
close_reason: Deferred: adding enums for visibility/status/rating would require updating all 3 servers + DB layer simultaneously. Current string validation at handler level is adequate. Revisit when refactoring to typed API crates.
